name: ntr_db_es_payout_Global
xsql:
SELECT 
    -- Top 1 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN name END), '') as top_1_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN division END), '') as top_1_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_1_val,
    100.0 as top_1_pct,

    -- Top 2 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN name END), '') as top_2_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN division END), '') as top_2_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_2_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_2_pct,

    -- Top 3 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN name END), '') as top_3_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN division END), '') as top_3_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_3_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 3 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_3_pct,

    -- Top 4 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN name END), '') as top_4_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN division END), '') as top_4_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_4_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 4 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_4_pct,

    -- Top 5 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN name END), '') as top_5_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN division END), '') as top_5_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_5_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 5 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_5_pct,

    -- Top 6 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN name END), '') as top_6_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN division END), '') as top_6_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_6_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 6 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_6_pct,

    -- Top 7 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN name END), '') as top_7_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN division END), '') as top_7_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_7_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 7 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_7_pct,

    -- Top 8 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN name END), '') as top_8_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN division END), '') as top_8_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_8_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 8 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_8_pct,

    -- Top 9 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN name END), '') as top_9_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN division END), '') as top_9_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_9_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 9 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_9_pct,

    -- Top 10 Performer
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN name END), '') as top_10_name,
    Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN division END), '') as top_10_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') as top_10_val,
    Round(Coalesce(Max(CASE WHEN rank = 10 THEN (payout * 100.0) / CASE WHEN max_payout = 0 THEN 1 ELSE max_payout END END), 0), 0) as top_10_pct

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name, 
        division, 
        payout,
        Max(payout) Over () as max_payout,
        Row_Number() Over (Order By payout Desc) as rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SubString(p.participant_name, 0, IndexOf(p.participant_name, '(')) AS name, 
            m.category AS division, 
            SUM(p.amount) AS payout
        FROM xactly.xc_payment p
        
        -- Embedded Title Mapping
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                pta.title_name AS title_name
            FROM xactly.xc_period per 
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
            WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        
        INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
            ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
            AND pta.title_name = m.title
            
        WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
          AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        GROUP BY 
            p.participant_name,
            m.category
    ) AggregatedData
) RankedData
WHERE rank <= 10;
